caption: A seagull walks across a wet beach at low tide, and its reflection shows beneath it on the thin sheet of water.

sa.check: A seagull walks across a wet beach.
Its reflection shows beneath it on the sheet of water.
It is low tide and the water is a thin sheet.

pc.expect: The inverted reflection appears only where the sand is covered by water and follows the bird's steps.
pc.fail: It appears on dry sand; or stays still while the bird walks; or it is missing on plainly wet sand.

pc.expect: The reflection is inverted and joined at the feet.
pc.fail: It is upright; or detached; or a different bird.

pc.expect: The water is a thin liquid sheet: the reflection breaks up in the footprints.
pc.fail: It is rigid like glass; or the footprints leave the reflection intact; or the water flows uphill.

pc.expect: The reflection does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It moves with the bird still; or drifts across the sand.
A second bird appears; or the reflection rises off the sand; or the bird vanishes; or the reflection becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The plumage and the beach stay the same.
pc.fail: The plumage changes; or the beach rearranges; or the sea changes.

note: Self-driven animal: where it goes and how it moves are not judged. Only the reflection's relation to it is.
